parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS d
)
INSERT INTO mcp_tool_calls (
  request_id,
  tool_name,
  arguments_json,
  status,
  client_name
)
SELECT
  NULLIF(d->>'request_id', '')::uuid,
  d->>'tool_name',
  COALESCE(d->'arguments_json', '{}'::jsonb),
  'started',
  NULLIF(d->>'client_name', '')
FROM input
RETURNING
  id AS audit_id,
  started_at;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS d
)
UPDATE mcp_tool_calls
SET
  status = d->>'status',
  error_code = NULLIF(d->>'error_code', ''),
  error_message = NULLIF(d->>'error_message', ''),
  duration_ms = NULLIF(d->>'duration_ms', '')::integer,
  completed_at = now()
FROM input
WHERE id = (d->>'audit_id')::uuid
RETURNING
  id AS audit_id,
  status,
  completed_at;
